dataset_scopes.DS1_qualified_best: 0.575577 km, information-weighted fixed-identity exact rate refinement; reused development evidence, not an untouched holdout.
dataset_scopes.DS2_22: Published 22-capture snapshot d27cd889. Best recorded all-session point was bounded consistent cap-800 at 3.039075 km; best fresh fine arm was the baseline/shared/regularized tie at 3.158768 km.
dataset_scopes.DS3_56: Fresh 56-capture freeze. Thirty-four captures require new tracking products. Every positioning result is pending.

common_protocol.admission: Bind manifest sha256:31ccb4b99d784ace58fc891cda43d00f5c5907c4df7df27fa4f483708b4d711b, complete tracking for all 56, and freeze eligibility plus all receipt/cache digests.
common_protocol.ordinary_scope: Every capture among the 56 that passes the single predeclared positioning eligibility rule; publish every exclusion and reject a 22-capture fallback.
common_protocol.geometry_scope: Exactly the five eligible IDs in geometry-cone-plan.json. This supersedes DS2's conservative three-binding scope after direct capture-time audit verified embedded LT3D bindings for 294be and ff02. The other 51 captures remain excluded.
common_protocol.search: Same blind 250 km prior, initial cells, refinement spacings, beam, edge-continuation rule and compute bound for the six general arms where their model permits.
common_protocol.holdout: Freeze randomized whole-session folds stratified by radio, sample rate and DS2 membership. Keep each session intact and fit preprocessing only on training folds.
common_protocol.reference: Reject reference/truth fields in inference. Verify inference seals before a separate evaluator receives the reference coordinate.
common_protocol.objective: Report the declared selection objective plus a common 800 Hz-capped all-observation score; never compare raw scores across unequal scopes.
common_protocol.compute: Four workers, one BLAS thread each, immutable resumable checkpoints and a measured preflight before approving the full run.

all_models: all input digests and the planned session set match
all planned cells and folds complete or explicitly fail
winner is interior at final geographic spacing or the result is unqualified
timing: timing winner is interior to the predeclared tau bounds
regularization scale is frozen before evaluation
report tau-bound hits and association churn
rate: every accepted finalist passes exact receipt-bound SGP4 replay within 0.2 Hz
report rate-bound hits and the matched no-rate control
cache derivatives screen only; exact replay decides
association: preserve the full causal candidate catalogue and unassigned component
report unassigned mass and identity stability
do not claim calibrated probabilities without calibration evidence
cap800: proposal and exact selection use the same 800 Hz cap
fresh DS3 parent and support only
bounded result is labeled local and not a fresh wide-prior result
geometry: session is one of the five IDs sealed in geometry-cone-plan.json
receiver-labelled causal track join is complete
both RX-to-axis mappings are marginalized unless mapping is independently confirmed
relative receiver phase and phase-derived directions are absent
fit/choice parameters use training or development rows only
compare only against matched controls on the same five sessions
